**Texere 0.4.19** · 13 November 2026

- **The PDF no longer reloads** when you highlight or delete a highlight (no more white flash): only the page is redrawn.
- **New versions are only shown** on Texere's home page, with **Update**; nothing installs by itself.

Also in this version (from 0.4.15–0.4.17): choose whether a Zotero reference comes with its PDF and annotations; the pointer in PDFs selects without copying into the note; faster highlights; @ citations from Zotero without Better BibTeX; the bibliography right after the text.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
